questions.question:
**In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.**

Blood transfusion is a procedure that starts with the doctor (1) ________ the patients' blood type. In case of a wrong transfusion in the immune (2) ________ of an individual, it leads to an infection.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **determining; system**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Determining **refers to a method or process of finding out or establishing something. (निर्धारण)
 
• In the context of blood transfusion, it is crucial to identify and establish the patient's blood type before proceeding with the transfusion.
 
• The word "**determining**" fits well to convey the idea of finding out the patient's blood type.
 
• **System **refers to the ways or methods by which a system operates or functions. (व्यवस्था)
 
• The phrase "**immune system**" refers to the complex network of cells and proteins that defend the body against infections.
 
• A wrong blood transfusion can trigger an immune response and result in an infection, making "**system**" the suitable word to complete the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

**Complete Passage**: *Blood transfusion is a procedure that starts with the doctor **(1) ****determining** __the patients' blood type. In case of a wrong transfusion in the immune **(2) __system __**of an individual, it leads to an infection.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Diagnosing: **Identifying or determining the nature or cause of a problem or condition. (निदान करना)
 
• **Structure: **The arrangement or organization of parts that make up a whole. (संरचना)
 
• **Treating: **Providing medical care, therapy, or taking actions to alleviate or cure a disease, condition, or problem. (इलाज)
 
• **Process: **A series of actions, steps, or operations conducted to achieve a particular result or outcome. (प्रक्रिया)
 
• **Settling: **Resolving or reaching a conclusion in a dispute, argument, or uncertainty. (तलछट)
 
• **Order: **Arrangement or organization, often based on a specific system or set of rules. (आदेश)

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

I have made the basket for going to the picnic and I‘ve packed some sandwiches ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"too".** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Let's evaluate each option:**

 
 
• **Two - **This is a numeral and suggests a quantity of two sandwiches.

 
 
• Depending on the context, this could be a valid choice, but without knowing if the user wants to specify a quantity, we can't select this as the most appropriate choice.
 
 
 
• **Too - **This word is used as a synonym for **"also" **or **"as well". **
 
 
• **​**In this context, it implies that, in addition to making the basket for the picnic, the speaker has also packed some sandwiches.
 
• The sentence would correctly read: **"I have made the basket for going to the picnic and I‘ve packed some sandwiches *too__*."**
 
 
 
• **To - **This is a preposition or part of an infinitive verb (to + verb), and it doesn't fit appropriately in this sentence.
 
• **Toot - **This is a noun that represents the sound of a horn. It doesn't make sense in the context of this sentence.
 
 
 
• In conclusion, the sentence is correctly completed as: **"I have made the basket for going to the picnic and I've packed some sandwiches *__too.__*"**

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
